Boss.Description.AntiBishop: A digit may not repeat on a diagonal within two steps. Example: a 5 rules out 5s one and two cells away diagonally.
Boss.Description.Antiking: No two cells a chess king's move apart may hold the same digit. Example: 3 cannot be next to or diagonal to another 3.
Boss.Description.Antiknight: No two cells a chess knight's move apart may hold the same digit.
Boss.Description.ArrowSums: Arrow: circle digit equals the sum of arrow digits. Example: 9=3+2+4.
Boss.Description.BetweenLines: Interior cells are strictly between endpoint values. Example: 2-[4,5]-8.
Boss.Description.BoxWipe: Wrong placement: all your digits in that box are erased.
Boss.Description.CellBlur: Wrong placement: the digits around it are hidden for 3 correct placements.
Boss.Description.CellLock: Wrong placement: the cell locks for 3 correct placements before you can edit it again.
Boss.Description.ColWipe: Wrong placement: all your digits in that column are erased.
Boss.Description.ConsecutiveLine: Adjacent cells on orange lines must differ by exactly 1. Example: 3-4-5 or 7-6-5.
Boss.Description.CrossWipe: Wrong placement: all your digits in that row and column are erased.
Boss.Description.DifferenceKropki: White dots: adjacent cells differ by 1. Example: 4-5.
Boss.Description.DistanceGe2: Equal digits must be at least 2 cells apart (Chebyshev distance). No two adjacent or diagonal cells may share a digit.
Boss.Description.DoublePenalty: Wrong placements deal double HP damage.
Boss.Description.DutchWhispers: Adjacent cells on teal lines must differ by 4 or more. Example: 1-6-2-7.
Boss.Description.EntropyGlobal: Every 3 consecutive cells in any row or column must contain one low (1–3), one mid (4–6), and one high (7–9) digit.
Boss.Description.EvenOdd: Marked cells must match: blue square = even, orange circle = odd.
Boss.Description.FogOfWar: Fog hides unsolved cells. Correct placements reveal neighbors.
Boss.Description.FortressCells: Grey-shaded cells must be strictly greater than every orthogonally adjacent non-shaded cell.
Boss.Description.FullKropki: All adjacent pairs that differ by 1 show a white dot; all 1:2 ratio pairs show a black dot. Absence of a dot forbids both relations.
Boss.Description.GermanWhispers: Adjacent cells on green lines must differ by 5 or more. Example: 1-7-2-8.
Boss.Description.GivenReveal: Wrong placement: up to 2 of your correct digits turn into fixed givens.
Boss.Description.GreaterLessThan: Chevrons (> or <) between adjacent cells show which must be the larger digit.
Boss.Description.KillerCages: Cages: cells sum to the shown total, no repeats. Example: 14=[5,9].
Boss.Description.ModularRegions: Every region must contain at least one digit from {1–3}, one from {4–6}, and one from {7–9}.
Boss.Description.NonconsecDiagonal: Diagonally adjacent cells cannot contain consecutive digits. Example: 4 cannot be diagonal to 3 or 5.
Boss.Description.Nonconsecutive: No two orthogonally adjacent cells may be consecutive.
Boss.Description.Palindrome: Lines read the same forwards and backwards. Example: 3-7-5-7-3.
Boss.Description.ParityLines: Cells along purple lines alternate odd/even. Example: 3-4-7-2.
Boss.Description.PencilBlind: Wrong placement: all pencil marks in that row and column are cleared.
Boss.Description.PencilScramble: Wrong placement: every pencil mark on the board is scrambled.
Boss.Description.PrimeCells: Marked cells (shown with a P) must contain a prime digit: 2, 3, 5, or 7.
Boss.Description.RadiusWipe: Wrong placement: all your digits within two cells of it are erased.
Boss.Description.RatioKropki: Black dots: one cell is double the other. Example: 3-6.
Boss.Description.RenbanLines: Cells on orange lines form a consecutive set. Example: 3-5-4 (set {3,4,5}).
Boss.Description.RevealCost: Wrong placement: items are blocked for your next 2 correct placements.
Boss.Description.RowWipe: Wrong placement: all your digits in that row are erased.
Boss.Description.SlowThermo: Digits increase or stay equal along the thermometer from bulb to tip. Example: 2-2-3-5 is valid.
Boss.Description.SumKropki: A labelled dot between two cells means those two cells sum to the shown value.
Boss.Description.Thermo: Digits increase along thermometers from bulb to tip. Example: 2-4-6-8.
Boss.Description.UniqueSetLine: No digit may repeat anywhere on the line, independent of standard Sudoku rules.
Boss.Description.XVPairs: X between two cells: they sum to 10. V between two cells: they sum to 5.
Class.Passive.GardenMonk: Every 5 correct placements: +1 HP. Level 15+: every 4.
Class.Passive.KoiGambler: 33% wrong costs 0 HP; 33% correct grants +3 Gold.
Class.Passive.LanternSeer: Boss modifiers are 30% weaker. Before each boss puzzle, preview all active modifiers and reroll one for free.
Class.Passive.NumberFreak: After completing a puzzle with zero mistakes: +1 Reroll Token.
Class.Passive.QuietCartographer: Preview next node's star & board size after a perfect tile. If you then choose that node, its difficulty is reduced by ½ star (min 1★).
Class.Passive.ReedDuelist: Perfect no-pencil puzzle: +2 Pencil. Every 5 such puzzles in a run: +1 HP.
Class.Passive.ShrineArchivist: Each pencil mark placed has a 25% chance to auto-reveal the correct digit for that cell.
Class.Passive.StoneGardener: First item used each puzzle node is not consumed.
Harmony.Perk.Description.EmptyCanvas: No starting items. Reward slots are guaranteed Rare+.
Harmony.Perk.Description.MoonshadeOfferi: +20 gold, +2 pencil. First reward slot becomes Nothing.
Harmony.Perk.Description.ScholarsBurden: -1 item slot, +5 pencil, free InkWell start.
Harmony.Perk.Description.VoidWard: No positive floor effects. Start with 1 shield charge.
Item.Description.AnnotatedFolio: Reveal all candidates in a selected box. (ShrineArchivist exclusive)
Item.Description.BambooCompass: Highlight 2 cells where the next placement would likely violate an active constraint.
Item.Description.BambooScroll: Reveal the star rating of all upcoming path nodes.
Item.Description.DimLantern: Remove fog from 3 random hidden cells permanently. (LanternSeer exclusive)
Item.Description.DoubleOrQuits: Double gold from this puzzle or lose 1 HP. (KoiGambler exclusive)
Item.Description.Finder.Epic: Reveal ALL unsolved cells containing the selected digit.
Item.Description.Finder.NormalRare: Highlight {0} cell(s) matching the selected digit.
Item.Description.GardenLantern: Lift fog from the entire board for 15 seconds, then re-fog.
Item.Description.GardenRake: Clear all pencil marks in the selected row and column.
Item.Description.GinkgoLeaf: Undo the last mistake, restore the lost HP, and recover your combo.
Item.Description.GoldenKintsugiJar: Fix all current mistakes on the board and reveal the correct digits for all affected cells.
Item.Description.GoldenKoi: Grant +{0}g per star rating when this puzzle ends.
Item.Description.KoiDragonScale: Complete the most-filled row, column, or box.
Item.Description.KoiReflection.Epic: Reveal candidates for every unsolved cell in the board's most ambiguous zone (row/column/box with most open cells).
Item.Description.KoiReflection.NormalRar: Click {0} empty cell(s) to reveal their candidates.
Item.Description.MonksBeads: Your next 9 placements cost no pencil marks. (GardenMonk exclusive)
Item.Description.PatternScroll: Select {0} mechanic instance(s) to solve using the solution. ESC cancels.
Item.Description.PruningShears: Remove all invalid candidates from a cell, leaving only valid possibilities.
Item.Description.ReedPledge: Complete this puzzle using zero pencil marks for +2 HP. (ReedDuelist exclusive)
Item.Description.RicePaperUmbrella: Block the next mistake penalty (2 charges).
Item.Description.SilkFan: Generate {0} Shield. Shield absorbs HP damage before your health bar. While shielded, mistakes don't break your combo. Resets each puzzle.
Item.Description.Solver.Epic: Click a zone (row/column/box) to auto-complete it.
Item.Description.Solver.Normal: Fill a cell with its correct digit and highlight remaining candidates in its box.
Item.Description.Solver.Rare: Fill a cell with its correct digit and auto-complete its box.
Item.Description.SurveyNotes: Shows the board size and stars of every tile on this floor. (QuietCartographer exclusive)
Item.Description.TempleIncense: Click {0} empty cell(s) to fill their correct answer.
Item.Description.TempleStamp: Protect your HP this puzzle - all wrong placements deal 0 damage. Consumed on completion.
Item.Description.WindChime.Epic: Click a cell to fill its row + column + box.
Item.Description.WindChime.Normal: Choose row, column, OR box, then click a cell to fill it.
Item.Description.WindChime.Rare: Choose any 2 of row/column/box, then click a cell to fill them.
Item.Description.WornChisel: 30% discount at the next shop. (StoneGardener exclusive)
Item.Description.ZenSandSifter: Highlight all cells with exactly two candidates.
Narrative.ClassIntro.GardenMonk: You set one palm on warm stone. The garden's breath steadies with yours.
Narrative.ClassIntro.KoiGambler: A gold koi breaks the surface as you pass. Risk follows you like a lucky ripple.
Narrative.ClassIntro.LanternSeer: The lantern before you burns with a second shadow. Hidden rules show their edges early.
Narrative.ClassIntro.NumberFreak: You count the sand-ridges before the gate finishes opening. Patterns answer when you pressure them gently.
Narrative.ClassIntro.QuietCartographer: Your map is blank where the garden is alive. You mark routes by listening before moving.
Narrative.ClassIntro.ReedDuelist: You step lightly, reed blade low. A clean solve is a vow, not a flourish.
Narrative.ClassIntro.ShrineArchivist: Scroll cases whisper beneath your sleeve. Every candidate mark feels like a recovered inscription.
Narrative.ClassIntro.StoneGardener: Your chisel rests heavy at your belt. Broken paths can still be shaped into order.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.GardenMonk: Your breath breaks before the gate, then returns; patience will carry you back.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.KoiGambler: The gold koi dives before you can call the wager. Another ripple is already forming.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.LanternSeer: The lantern clouds over, but one ember keeps the hidden rule warm.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.NumberFreak: One count slipped from the pattern, but the unanswered digit stays in reach.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.QuietCartog: The map blurs at the edge of the garden. You still know where the first stone lies.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.ReedDuelist: The reed bends instead of breaking. The vow can be taken again.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.ShrineArchi: The archive closes on an unfinished page. Its margin waits for your next hand.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Defeat.StoneGarden: The path fractures under your step. You remember where the repair must begin.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.GardenMonk: The garden releases its breath with yours, and the last wound closes into quiet.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.KoiGambler: The koi turns gold beneath the torii. This time, the wager lands in your hand.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.LanternSee: Every hidden rule burns clear in the lantern glass, and the summit lets you pass.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.NumberFrea: The final pattern leaves no remainder; even the bell seems to count you home.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.QuietCarto: The living map completes itself behind you, one calm path at a time.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.ReedDuelis: Your final stroke is exact. The reeds bow without touching the water.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.ShrineArch: You bind the completed grid into memory; the archive has room for one more true route.
Narrative.ClassRunEnd.Victory.StoneGarde: Stone, moss, and number settle into one shape. Nothing loose remains to mend.
Narrative.FloorEntry.0: The bamboo gate opens with a dry clack. Raked sand curves ahead, each path asking for a steadier hand.
Narrative.FloorEntry.1: Moss softens the stones around the koi pond. Lantern light gathers in the water.
Narrative.FloorEntry.2: Wooden bridges cross black water. Orange koi turn below like living brushstrokes.
Narrative.FloorEntry.3: Stone lanterns wake one by one. The gravel path glows amber under drifting leaves.
Narrative.FloorEntry.4: The torii at the summit waits in mist. Every bell note sounds closer than it should.
Narrative.Node.Boss.0.0: Bamboo stalks snap in patterns no wind could make.
Narrative.Node.Boss.0.1: You solve before the grove changes its mind.
Narrative.Node.Boss.1.0: The pond spirit stirs under black water.
Narrative.Node.Boss.1.1: Every wrong step sends rings across the grid.
Narrative.Node.Boss.2.0: The bridge guardian lowers its paper fan.
Narrative.Node.Boss.2.1: Only a complete pattern earns passage.
Narrative.Node.Boss.3.0: Lanterns flare into a wall of gold and shadow.
Narrative.Node.Boss.3.1: You solve through the heat of their gaze.
Narrative.Node.Boss.4.0: The summit spirit waits beyond the torii.
Narrative.Node.Boss.4.1: The final board is an offering, and it will not accept haste.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.0.0: Black moss threads through the raked sand.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.0.1: The cursed route promises a sharper blessing if you do not look away.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.1.0: A koi with clouded scales circles the pond edge.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.1.1: The water offers strength with a shadow tied to it.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.2.0: The bridge boards creak in a rhythm that does not match your steps.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.2.1: Crossing here means carrying the echo forward.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.3.0: One lantern burns with smoke instead of flame.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.3.1: Its curse will follow until the pattern is satisfied.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.4.0: A cracked torii charm turns cold in your hand.
Narrative.Node.Cursed.4.1: The summit accepts risk only when it is named.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.0.0: A narrow service path slips behind the bamboo screen.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.0.1: The spirits watch the shortcut closely.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.1.0: The moss path breaks into slick stepping stones.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.1.1: One careless move will echo across the pond.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.2.0: A moon bridge arches higher than it should.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.2.1: You climb into a harder pattern.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.3.0: A lantern-lit side trail burns brighter than the main way.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.3.1: The reward is closer, and so is the risk.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.4.0: A hidden stair rises beside the torii.
Narrative.Node.ElitePuzzle.4.1: The summit spirits do not mark easy routes.
Narrative.Node.Event.0.0: A paper talisman lifts from the sand without wind.
Narrative.Node.Event.1.0: A ripple crosses the pond against the current.
Narrative.Node.Event.2.0: The bridge shadow lengthens into the shape of a gate.
Narrative.Node.Event.3.0: One lantern burns blue among the amber lights.
Narrative.Node.Event.3.1: Its flame bends toward your hand.
Narrative.Node.Event.4.0: At the summit, a sealed ema plaque turns over by itself.
Narrative.Node.Event.4.1: The last wish is not written in ink.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.0.0: A bamboo spirit rattles the grove ahead.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.0.1: The quiet route bends away; the direct path earns a sharper blessing.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.1.0: The koi pond darkens beneath a watching mask.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.1.1: You can circle the water, or cross where the ripples gather.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.2.0: A bridge guardian blocks the terrace.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.2.1: The safer stones are slower. The bright stones demand faith.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.3.0: Lantern flames lean toward the same unseen breath.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.3.1: Every path through the glow has a cost.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.4.0: The shrine gate seals behind you.
Narrative.Node.PreBoss.4.1: This is the final threshold. No way around.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.0.0: You step between bamboo shadows. The grid settles like raked sand.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.0.1: A clean path opens. You breathe and solve.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.1.0: Koi circle beneath the bridge. Their turns mark a quiet rhythm.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.1.1: Numbers fall into place like stones in moss.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.2.0: Water reflects the board in broken fragments.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.2.1: You follow the pattern until the surface stills.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.3.0: Lantern light divides the path into warm squares.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.3.1: Each correct digit feels like a wick catching flame.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.4.0: Mist curls around the shrine steps.
Narrative.Node.Puzzle.4.1: The last garden asks for patience, not speed.
Narrative.Node.Relic.0: An old charm glints between the bamboo roots.
Narrative.Node.Relic.1: A lacquered token rests on the moss, dry despite the pond mist.
Narrative.Node.Relic.2: Something bright turns beneath the bridge boards.
Narrative.Node.Relic.3: A lantern niche hides a relic wrapped in faded cord.
Narrative.Node.Relic.4: At the shrine threshold, a small offering waits for your hand.
Narrative.Node.Rest.0.0: A flat meditation stone sits warm in the courtyard.
Narrative.Node.Rest.0.1: You rest until the bamboo stops swaying.
Narrative.Node.Rest.1.1: For a moment, even the pond holds still.
Narrative.Node.Rest.2.0: You kneel beside the bridge and let the koi pass below.
Narrative.Node.Rest.2.1: Their patience returns some of yours.
Narrative.Node.Rest.3.0: A lantern niche offers shelter from the wind.
Narrative.Node.Rest.3.1: You count your breath with the flame.
Narrative.Node.Rest.4.0: The shrine bell rope hangs within reach.
Narrative.Node.Rest.4.1: You do not ring it yet. You rest.
Narrative.Node.Shop.0.0: A fox-mask keeper waits beside a tray of paper charms.
Narrative.Node.Shop.1.0: A lacquered stall rests by the koi pond.
Narrative.Node.Shop.1.1: "Tools for patient hands, prices for honest ones."
Narrative.Node.Shop.2.0: Under the bridge, a spirit merchant unfolds a silk cloth.
Narrative.Node.Shop.2.1: "Rare things drift here when no one is looking."
Narrative.Node.Shop.3.0: Lantern smoke curls around a quiet shrine shop.
Narrative.Node.Shop.3.1: "Spend what you carried. Keep what carries you."
Narrative.Node.Shop.4.0: At the final torii, the keeper opens one last box.
Narrative.RunEnd.Defeat.0.0: The lanterns dim one by one. The garden keeps the unfinished pattern.
Narrative.RunEnd.Defeat.0.1: You will be allowed to enter again.
Narrative.RunEnd.Victory.0.0: The summit bell answers without being struck. Behind you, every garden path settles into stillness.
Narrative.RunEnd.Victory.0.1: You pass through the torii with the pattern complete.
Relic.Description.AccurateMap: Every floor: shows the board size and stars of every tile and guarantees one relic-tier reward node. (QuietCartographer exclusive)
Relic.Description.CrackedStone: [H2+] Each mistake after the first in a puzzle deals 0 HP (stone absorbs). Passive; unlimited.
Relic.Description.CrackedTeacup: Absorb the first mistake each puzzle (no HP loss).
Relic.Description.CrimsonFan: Reduce all boss modifier intensities by one step.
Relic.Description.DragonsEye: Start each puzzle with one fully solved box.
Relic.Description.DuelingReed: Completing a puzzle with zero pencil marks grants +20 bonus gold. (ReedDuelist exclusive)
Relic.Description.EndlessArchive: After each correct placement, reveal one candidate in the same row. (ShrineArchivist exclusive)
Relic.Description.FortunesLedger: Every 10 correct placements: +1 Reroll Token. Every 5-hit combo: +2 Reroll Tokens. (NumberFreak exclusive)
Relic.Description.FrostedMirror: [H5+] Once per mistake: spend 3 pencil to absorb 1 HP of damage (auto-triggers if pencil ≥ 3). At H5+ each hit after the first in a puzzle is partially reduced.
Relic.Description.GildedKoiScale: Boosts Koi Gambler procs to 40%: lucky hit grants +5 gold, absorbed mistake grants +1 Reroll Token. (KoiGambler exclusive)
Relic.Description.GoldenRoot: At floor start, gain 30% of the gold spent during the previous floor.
Relic.Description.KoiReflectionRelic: Reveal the correct candidates for 5 random empty cells at puzzle start (no auto-fill).
Relic.Description.LanternOfVoid: [H9+] Boss modifier labels are always hidden (no auto-reveal on repeat). Earn +1 gold per active floor modifier on puzzle completion.
Relic.Description.LoadBearingStone: Each non-absorbed mistake generates 5 bonus gold at end of puzzle. (StoneGardener exclusive)
Relic.Description.PaperCrane: First item use each puzzle is free (no charge cost).
Relic.Description.PhoenixFeather: Prevent death once per run (heal to 1 HP).
Relic.Description.PorcelainMask: Elite reward rarity upgraded by one tier.
Relic.Description.SakuraSeal: Perfect-puzzle streak: +1 HP at streak >=2; +3 HP (reset) at streak >=5.
Relic.Description.ShiftingGarden: Once per floor, a random given digit is relocated to another valid cell, keeping the puzzle uniquely solvable.
Relic.Description.SilentGrid: Start each floor with 3 fresh mistake-shield charges (each absorbed mistake costs 0 HP).
Relic.Description.SmoothPebble: Start each puzzle with +2 pencil marks.
Relic.Description.TempleVow: When HP drops to 25% or below, heal 3 HP once per puzzle. (GardenMonk exclusive)
Relic.Description.VoidPetal: [H7+] Once per run: survive a lethal hit at 1 HP. Grants 1 free Normal Solver upon activation.
Relic.Description.WardingFlame: Once per run, automatically absorb one mistake (no HP loss). (LanternSeer exclusive)
Relic.Description.WisteriaBranch: Heal 2 HP at the start of each floor.
